name: Hamburg nurse seeking confirmed daytime work

context.employment_state: Employed; seeking a more predictable alternative
constraints: Actual rota evidence, not generic work-life balance
context.company_awareness: Knows UKE and Asklepios; open to smaller outpatient and day clinics

trigger: A new rota includes nights again, prompting a search for a clinic or outpatient position with explicitly compatible hours.

searches_run.observation: Retrieval returned direct Asklepios and alanta day-clinic vacancies alongside job boards. Direct inspection of alanta confirmed permanent part-time employment and general regular-hours wording, but no exact rota or explicit no-night statement.

searches_run.query: Pflegefachkraft Hamburg ohne Nachtdienst feste Arbeitszeiten ambulant
searches_run.observation: Results included no-night claims from placement/aggregation pages and an outpatient nursing listing categorized with shift/night/weekend work. Outpatient work alone therefore did not establish this constraint.

sources.title: Pflegefachkraft Tagesklinik und Institutsambulanz — alanta
sources.supports: Direct inspection shows Hamburg, 25–30 hours weekly, permanent contract and regular-hours wording; the inspected text does not specify exact start/end times or exclude nights explicitly.

sources.title: Pflegefachkraft Geriatrische Tagesklinik — Asklepios
sources.supports: Retrieved employer result establishes a day-clinic nursing vacancy category in Hamburg, not verified shift terms.

sources.title: Ambulante Pflege Hamburg-Billbrook — Pflegero
sources.supports: Retrieved placement page advertises no nights and early/late shifts; claims were not independently verified.

sources.title: Pflegefachkraft ambulanter Pflegedienst Hamburg-Altona — BA
sources.supports: Retrieved listing includes shift/night/weekend labeling despite an outpatient title.

best_entry_page.promise: Help compare employer-stated hours for nursing roles and identify the rota questions still unanswered before applying.
proof_needed: Dated source passages for every claimed shift arrangement
Unknown values where hours are absent
Separate no-night work from no-weekend or fixed daytime work
Explain that text matching does not verify a rota
New indexable guide; existing company/search pages are noindex

conversion_objections: Are these hospitals and smaller clinics actually covered?
Does no night shift still mean late shifts and weekends?
Is this the employing clinic or a staffing agency?
Will a generic regular-hours phrase be treated as proof?
Why pay if I still have to ask the employer for a rota?

avoid_targeting.reason: Only the employer can substantiate actual rota arrangements.
Medical advice is outside this employment search and product scope.
Employer scheduling software is a different audience.

message_to_founder: Simulation: Ich kenne schon einige Kliniken, aber deren Namen sagen mir nichts über den konkreten Dienstplan. Zeigt mir genau, was zur Arbeitszeit in der Anzeige steht, und lasst offen, was ich noch erfragen muss.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic persona. Two retrieval queries and one direct inspection; remaining searches are hypotheses. No medical or employment-law advice. No vacancy, rota, employer coverage or no-night guarantee is independently verified. Search results demonstrate wording differences, not their prevalence.

search_journey.fit_reason: Occupation/location search fits if coverage exists.
Facility type is relevant but not proof of hours.
Titles can guide discovery but cannot guarantee no nights.
